title: Polished Petrified Wood
description: The grain runs the long way on this piece of petrified wood. I like how the polish picks out those thin brown lines. You can follow one nearly from end to end.

title: Amethyst Tower
description: There’s a pale patch just under the point of this amethyst, then the purple deepens again farther down. I photographed it upright so you can see both on the same face.

title: Amethyst Tower
description: I held this slender amethyst against the daylight. The tip is the darkest purple part, and the long face gets pale enough near the base to see light through it.

title: Azurite-Malachite Specimen
description: Look between the green bumps and you’ll find patches of deep blue. That’s the part I’d look at up close on this azurite-malachite. The surface has as much going on as the color.

title: Rainbow Fluorite Tower
description: Two inches tall. I held this fluorite up to the light so you can see the narrow pinkish stripe down in the purple. Up near the point, the edge turns blue-green.

title: Rainbow Fluorite Tower2
description: I’d start at the point on this fluorite and work down. There’s a narrow purple stripe just under the tip, a broad blue-green stretch, then a much darker purple foot.

title: Rainbow Fluorite Tower
description: Almost the whole lower half looks dark until you catch the reddish band slanting across it. I like that little patch of blue right up at the point of this fluorite.

title: Rainbow Fluorite Tower
description: That pale stripe runs uphill across the purple. I can follow it right around the corner onto the next face of this fluorite.

title: Rainbow Fluorite Tower
description: If I wanted to show somebody banding on a little fluorite point, I’d hand them this one. The stripes run almost level across it, pale green under the purple tip and darker blue and violet below.

title: Montana Agate Slab with Water-lines
description: I count the fine white lines first, then notice the wider smoky bands between them. They run almost level across this Montana agate slice, right out to the cut edge.

title: Polished Montana Agate Slab
description: This slice of Montana agate has a rusty patch on one side that breaks up into little flecks across the milky part. I like it best with that uneven top edge showing.

title: Polished Flower Agate Slab
description: I can follow this flower agate from the cloudy white end, through a patch of gray and down to a little pocket of honey color. It’s a long, narrow slab with room to see the changes in order.

title: Sardonyx Palm Stone
description: I see amber first on this sardonyx, then a deeper red down one side. The rounded face lets the color show all the way to the edge.

title: Unakite Heart
description: I like where the pink and green meet on this unakite heart. Follow the pink streak up from the bottom and it forks across the face.

title: Lapis Lazuli with Pyrite Heart
description: Most of this heart is deep blue lapis. I keep coming back to the corner where that blue gives way to a much paler patch with little flecks of pyrite.

title: Green Aventurine Palm Stone
description: I photographed this aventurine beside a sunflower. The face is a quiet blue-green with a few cloudy spots, and the rounded edge catches a thin line of light.

title: Kambaba Jasper Palm Stone
description: There’s a pale green curl tucked into the dark face of this Kambaba jasper. I can see it best just off center. The stone has a rounded, almost square outline in the hand.

title: Brecciated Jasper Necklace
description: This brecciated jasper hangs point down. What I like about that cut is how the dark patch crosses the middle and the wine-red stone comes back on both sides of it.

title: Mystery Tumbled Pendant
description: I’ve shown my tumbled pendants together on the rack so you can see the range of shapes. Some are long and narrow, some barely longer than they are wide. This is the mystery pendant listing.

title: Carnelian Flower Tower
description: Sunlight comes through the middle of this carnelian tower, but the foot stays a deeper red. I can see one little dark mark just below the point.

title: Kambaba Jasper Tower
description: One face of this Kambaba jasper is dark enough to look almost black. On the adjoining green face I can pick out little round markings all the way down toward the base.

title: Smokey Quartz Point
description: I held this smoky quartz point where light could reach the base. The tip is so dark you can barely see into it, but there’s warm brown showing through below.

title: Brazilian Agate Slab
description: That little notch at the bottom is where my eye goes first. Hold the slab up to the light and you can follow its shape in the amber band below the cream center. The display stand comes with this Brazilian agate.

title: Franklinite Specimen
description: In my hand this piece of franklinite looks almost square. The face is mottled gray and black with lighter patches, and you can see the uneven edge along the top.

title: Green Moss Agate Tower
description: There’s a thick patch of green high in this moss agate tower and another near the base. I like the clear stretch between them. It gives you a look past the surface.

title: Amethyst Tower
description: I set this amethyst upright for the photo to show the pale band just below its point. The purple below it runs nearly the full length of the tower.

title: Sardonyx Banded Agate Palm Stone
description: Thin brown and cream lines curve together like they’ve been combed over one side of this sardonyx. I like the single red streak that interrupts them near the top.

title: Montana Agate Palmstone
description: I laid this Montana agate flat so you could see the whole smooth oval. One end is smoky brown and the other lets a little honey-colored light through.

title: Brazilian Agate Slab
description: I held this Brazilian agate by the rim so the light could get behind the pale center. Look for the small dark mark near the middle and the uneven gray edge all around it.

title: Polished Plume Agate Slab
description: The outline on this plume agate is half the fun. I’d display it with the high shoulder to the left so you can follow the bumps along the top and the honey-colored patches below.

title: Polished Crazy Lace Slab
description: I see a long wedge of rusty red first. Up close, the cut face of this crazy lace slab breaks into darker patches with pale little swirls between them.

title: Polished Brazilian Agate Slab
description: I like the space around the markings in this Brazilian agate. There are only a few dark flecks in that broad milky face, with most of the warm brown down along the bottom.

title: Polished Plume Agate Slab
description: This plume agate rises to a point on one side. I like the way the gray and amber patches bunch together right under that sloping edge.

title: Polished Plume Agate Slab
description: There’s a step in the top of this plume agate, almost like two little peaks. I can see warm brown below each one and a darker, flatter strip across the foot.

title: Ruby Zoisite Tower
description: I’d recognize this ruby zoisite by the dark marks running across the green. A reddish patch sits partway down one long face, with black specks scattered almost to the foot.

title: Ruby Zoisite Tower
description: Green takes up most of the face on this ruby zoisite tower. I like the dark mark just below the point, and the way the scattered flecks get farther apart toward the base.

title: Brazilian Agate Necklace
description: This Brazilian agate hangs broad side out, with rounded corners and a dark patch up by the bail. I like the warm yellow that shows below it when light gets behind the stone.

title: Brazilian Agate Necklace
description: This Brazilian agate is a narrow, slanted cut. I like being able to follow the darker bands straight across that long amber face.

title: Mariposite Necklace
description: I cut this mariposite to a diamond shape. The pale green runs nearly white in places, so the darker green patches are easy to pick out.

title: Green Moss Agate
description: I set this pale moss agate with the narrow end up. It spreads into a little triangle below the bail, with fine markings you have to look close to see.

title: Rocky Butte Jasper Necklace
description: This Rocky Butte jasper is a little rectangle with the corners softened. I like the mix of gray and cream inside it and the warm patch up at the chain end.

title: Labradorite Free-form
description: In my photo the top of this labradorite flashes gold and the face below it shows blue-green. Those dark lines cutting through the color stay easy to pick out at that angle.

title: Honeycomb Ruby Tower
description: Up close, the pink-red face of this tower is peppered with little dark pits. I’d start there before looking at the outline of the point.

title: Brazilian Agate with Druzy Portal
description: I held this agate with light behind the opening so you can see clear through it. The pale, sparkling rim of that little window really stands out against the smoky bands.

title: Celestite Geode
description: There’s an opening in the face of this celestite geode just big enough to draw your eye inside. I photographed it in my palm to show the blue-gray crystals around the darker pocket.

title: Bloodstone Sphere
description: The red patch is the first thing I’d look for on this bloodstone sphere. Most of the stone showing around it is a dark, mottled green.

title: Aura Rainbow Fluorite Tower
description: I set this fluorite point upright for the picture. There’s purple in the tip and a stack of slanted, pale stripes below it. A stripe changes direction at the edge between two faces.

title: Golden Mica Tower
description: This golden mica tower is pale enough that the little flecks can be easy to miss. I like the side where they catch the light against that warm cream color.

title: Golden Tiger’s Eye Tower
description: I photographed this tiger’s eye with the narrow gold streak facing forward. Follow it from the foot nearly to the point and you can see just how dark the neighboring face is.

title: Polished Cotton Candy Agate Slab
description: The top edge dips in the middle of this cotton candy agate slab. I like how the white follows that dip and meets the pink in a ragged line across the face.

title: Polished Plume Agate Slab
description: There’s a little bite out of the edge of this brown plume agate. I’d turn that side toward you. Look just above the notch for the finer markings in the stone.

title: Polished Jasper Slab
description: I can count the layers on this jasper slab from across the bench. Up close those rusty brown stripes break into dots and short dashes over a much paler face.

title: Polished Montana Moss Agate
description: This Montana moss agate looks charcoal gray in my photo. Look just above the long lower edge and you can pick out a pale line running through the darker stone.

title: Polished Plume Agate Slab
description: Most of the amber color sits on one side of this plume agate. I see a whole different pattern on the other side, where white and dark flecks crowd the edge.

title: Golden Healer Tower
description: I can see brown right through the tip of this Golden Healer tower in the photo. A dark line cuts diagonally across the face below it, then runs into a rusty patch farther down.

title: Flower Agate Tower
description: The rust-colored marks form a narrow trail up the middle of this pale flower agate tower. I like how the trail thins out before it reaches the point.

title: Lace Agate Tower
description: What I notice about this lace agate tower is how the markings run lengthwise. There’s a thin amber streak partway up the dark front face, with pale stone along one edge.

title: Moonstone with Tourmaline Inclusions Necklace
description: I set this moonstone wide at the shoulders and point down. The darkest tourmaline sits near that bottom point, with smaller black flecks scattered up through the pale stone.

title: Dead Camel Jasper Necklace
description: There’s one dark, jagged mark I always spot first on this Dead Camel jasper. It cuts in from the side of a dusty rose oval, with a smaller mark below it.

title: Wonderstone Necklace
description: Look down near the wide end of this wonderstone pendant. I see a little set of nested arches there, cream around ocher, all tucked into the corners of the cut.

title: Morrisonite Jasper Necklace
description: I gave this Morrisonite jasper a narrow top and a broad, straight foot. The long taper leaves a streak of warm brown running down the face like a strip of woodgrain.

title: Snowflake Obsidian Necklace
description: I can pick out the white patches on this snowflake obsidian from a few steps back. The biggest sits down near a rounded corner, with black stone showing between the patches.

title: Green Moss Agate
description: I set this moss agate with its broad, round face forward. Most of it looks dark, but light comes through a warm-colored patch along the bottom edge in the photo.

title: Green Moss Agate
description: In my photo this moss agate hangs on a dark cord. The stone tapers toward the loop, and fine gray-green wisps show against the much paler part of the face.

title: Flower Lace Agate
description: I kept the sides of this flower lace agate straight. There’s a diagonal wash of peach across the little rectangle, darker at the bottom than up by the bail.

title: Green Moss Agate
description: I hung this moss agate on a pale cord for its picture. The stone has rounded shoulders and a gray-green face with little cloudy patches across it.

title: Purple Fluorite Necklace
description: This purple fluorite is darkest at its broad, flat bottom. I can trace a pale stripe across the narrower end and a finer one below it.

title: Green Moss Agate
description: I like the patch of green just off center on this moss agate. There’s enough pale stone around it to see the finer specks right out to the rounded corners.

title: African Queen Picture Jasper Necklace
description: I see a dark outline running down one side of this picture jasper, with a little pale patch inside it. The rest of the pendant is finely speckled tan.

title: Volcano Agate Heart
description: I photographed this agate heart in the sun. A dark band hugs one shoulder, disappears behind the broad pale face and shows again at the far edge.

title: Mexican Crazy Lace Tower
description: I like the pale curls tucked in under the tip of this crazy lace tower. Below them the face goes cream, while a rusty brown strip runs almost the whole way down one edge.

title: Mexican Crazy Lace Tower
description: I’d turn this crazy lace tower to the face with the upside-down V. There’s a bright patch of amber just below it and a much darker reddish brown up toward the point.

title: Mexican Crazy Lace Tower
description: There’s a lot of pale stone in this crazy lace point. I keep noticing the narrow brown streak down low where it meets the darker patch along the foot.

title: Carnelian Palmstone
description: I held this carnelian flat in my hand to show the bands curling around the red center. The narrow amber line near the edge follows almost the same curve as the stone.

title: Fluorite with Tourmaline Inclusions Tower
description: Look toward the base of this fluorite tower and you’ll see pale green. My favorite part is higher up, where the thin dark tourmaline marks show against the nearly clear stone.

title: Polished Coral Agate Slab
description: I held this coral agate slice up by the window. The center lets light through, but the dark scalloped band along the upper edge still stands out.

title: Wonderstone Necklace
description: The sides of this wonderstone are straight, but the bands double back on themselves. I set it with that tight U down near the bottom of the rectangle.

title: Jafar Jasper Necklace
description: One side of this Jafar jasper is rusty orange and the other is nearly black. I hung it with the low point off to one side, right where those two colors meet.

title: Crazy Lace Agate Necklace
description: This piece of crazy lace hangs broad end down on a dark cord. I like the thin pale line running diagonally through the pink, just above the wide end.

title: Crazy Lace Agate Necklace
description: I set this long, narrow crazy lace so the wavy pale stripe runs from top to bottom. It bends around a darker red patch near the rounded tip.

title: Sunset Sodalite Tower
description: I’d show this sodalite from the blue end up. A broken white band crosses the lower face and the rusty orange shows strongest near the point.

title: African Queen Picture Jasper Necklace
description: The dark stripe cuts diagonally across this picture jasper. It’s full of little flecks when I look close, and the tan stone on either side has a much finer grain.

title: African Queen Picture Jasper Necklace
description: I laid this necklace flat so you can see how the diagonal bands meet the cut edges. There’s a dark pencil-thin line across the sandy face and a wider pale band near the bottom.

title: Mexican Crazy Lace Agate Necklace
description: From the bail to the rounded end, this crazy lace agate changes from brown to cloudy cream and back to a deep reddish brown. I like the pale band where it crosses the widest part of the drop.

title: Purple Moss Agate Necklace
description: I can see the darkest mossy markings gathered along the bottom of this purple agate. There’s a whole stretch of open lavender above them, all the way to the bail.

title: Blue Apatite Necklace
description: I cut this apatite with one long straight side and a point off to the right. The bright blue runs through the middle, with little dark marks that show up against it.

title: Ocean Jasper Necklace
description: I like the way this ocean jasper narrows almost to a stem up at the chain. The colors change along its length from olive to honey, with a pale patch at the rounded end.

title: Agatized Petrified Wood with Quartz Inclusions Necklace
description: This oval of agatized petrified wood has a pale seam running up from the bottom. I set it lengthwise so you can follow that seam between the brown patches.

title: Dead Camel Jasper Necklace
description: I like what happens in the corners of this Dead Camel jasper. A dark branching mark works its way across the pale rectangle toward a patch of pink up near the chain.

title: Oregon Picture Jasper Necklace
description: I left a broad rectangular face on this picture jasper. The gray middle sits between two brown areas, with a ragged line hanging down from the top one like a little overhang.

title: Dendritic Jasper Necklace
description: I laid this dendritic jasper flat for the photo. Up close there are dark, branching marks across the cream, and a thicker brown patch out toward the low corner.

title: Seraphinite Necklace
description: This seraphinite widens as it hangs, then turns to a short point at the bottom. I can see little pale strokes fanning out over the dark green face.

title: Seraphinite Necklace
description: I like this wider piece of seraphinite for the way its pale marks spread out across the green. The bottom corners are rounded and there’s room to follow the pattern from side to side.

title: Purple Fluorite Necklace
description: I cut this pale purple fluorite with a point at each end. A cloudy streak runs through the middle of the diamond, and the lavender deepens along one edge.

title: Mookaite Jasper Necklace
description: I set this mookaite so the pink and cream patches meet right across the wide end. Draw your eye up toward the bail and that broad patch narrows to a strip.

title: Purple Fluorite Necklace
description: This fluorite looks almost black in the middle of my photo. The violet is easiest to see toward the rounded edge, where a few fine pale lines cross the face.

title: Ocean Jasper Necklace
description: The little brown spots are why I like this piece of ocean jasper. You can follow them down the pale teardrop to the larger marking near its rounded end.

title: Mookaite Jasper Necklace
description: I set this mookaite with its narrow red-brown point down. The warm yellow streak on one side follows the curved outline almost like the edge of a leaf.

title: Agatized Petrified Wood
description: There’s a warm streak running lengthwise through this brown piece of agatized petrified wood. I set it as a drop with the grain running down from the chain.

title: Mahogany Obsidian Necklace
description: This mahogany obsidian has a band of black cutting through a rounded patch of reddish brown. I hung the pendant on a dark cord that picks up the black in the stone.

title: Brazilian Agate Necklace
description: I see this Brazilian agate in layers. The top is smoky, the next stretch is pale, and there’s a jagged brown line across the wide end of the pendant.

title: Brazilian Agate Necklace
description: I like the split in this agate teardrop. One side is warm amber with dark little markings, the other side is milky, and the two meet along a crooked line.

title: Brazilian Agate Necklace
description: The pale middle of this Brazilian agate gives the brown lines plenty of room. I can pick out one near the bail and a busier patch curling around the lower edge.

title: Owyhee Jasper Necklace
description: I set this peach-colored Owyhee jasper with the rusty patch at the foot. The smooth, rounded outline makes the ragged boundary between the two colors easy to see.

title: Owyhee Jasper Necklace
description: There’s a small brown patch near the bail and a much bigger one down at the opposite corner. I like how the pale face of this Owyhee jasper joins the two.

title: Owyhee Jasper Necklace
description: Most of the orange is up at the chain end of this jasper oval. I keep coming back to the little lacework of paler markings spreading up from below.

title: Agatized Biggs Jasper Necklace
description: I see a pale band across the middle of this Biggs jasper with a rusty patch just above it. Down near the foot, a finer brown line cuts across the banding at an angle.

title: Polychrome Jasper Necklace
description: I went wide at the foot and narrow at the top on this polychrome jasper. The lavender, cream and ocher run across it in layers, right out to the sloping sides.

title: Flower Lace Agate
description: The bottom edge of this flower lace agate is straight and wide enough to show the whole sweep of peach. I left it narrower at the bail, where the colors pinch together.

title: Flower Lace Agate
description: On this rectangle of flower lace agate, I see bands of tan and cream running at a slant. The straight sides make that slant easy to follow from edge to edge.

title: Fuchsite necklace
description: This fuchsite pendant has a blunt, uneven outline. I like how its pale and deeper green flecks run together right up to the edges.

title: Sodalite Necklace
description: I set this sodalite in a diamond shape with the white patch running across the wide part. The blue gets especially dark down toward the bottom point.

title: Mahogany Obsidian
description: I laid this mahogany obsidian necklace on the wood to show the rust-colored patch in the middle. Black stone wraps around it and forms a broad rim at the bottom.

title: Tiger's Eye Tower
description: The point on this tiger’s eye rises straight above a long narrow gold line. I’d turn that corner toward you first so you can see brown on both sides of it.

title: Chocolate Calcite Free-form
description: There’s a cream-colored patch set deep in the brown face of this chocolate calcite. I can follow the pale line around it and up over the rounded shoulder.

title: Moss Agate Tower with Carnelian Inclusions
description: At first I see a dark green moss agate point. Look down near the foot and there’s the reddish patch of carnelian, easy to miss against the green.

title: Brazilian Agate Necklace
description: This Brazilian agate has a dark plum-colored center with a thick honey-colored edge. I hung it wide side forward so you can see the whole uneven outline.

title: Petrified Wood Necklace
description: I set this piece of petrified wood with the dark grain running up toward the chain. The sides bend in and out, and a lighter brown strip follows one of those bends.

title: Cotton Candy Agate Necklace
description: The long point is what I like about this cotton candy agate. It carries the pink right down to the tip, with little milky patches showing across the wider part.

title: African Queen Picture Jasper Necklace
description: This picture jasper is striped all the way down its rectangular face. I like the fine tan lines on one side and the wider, darker strip that cuts past them at a slight angle.

title: Malachite Necklace
description: I followed a long sweep of green on this malachite. The pendant bends to one side, and the narrow pale bands follow that bend almost to the tip.

title: Sodalite Necklace
description: I laid this sodalite pendant flat on its cord. The blue face gets wider toward the bottom, where a light vein runs at an angle just above the edge.

title: Purple Moss Agate Necklace
description: The mossy patch gathers at the rounded end of this pale purple agate. I like how the rest of the drop stays light enough to see the darker wisps inside it.

title: Blue Mountain Jasper Necklace
description: Look near the outside of this Blue Mountain jasper oval. I see a pale line curving around the smoky blue-gray middle, almost picking out the same shape a second time.

title: Plume Agate Necklace
description: I cut this plume agate with broad shoulders and the dark patch down at the point. Above it the stone is milky, which makes the little branching marks stand out.

title: Malachite Necklace
description: I set this slim malachite upright. A dark green line runs almost the full length of the pendant and the bright green shows best on the side that curves outward.

title: Malachite Necklace
description: This is my triangular malachite pendant. The pale green band curves along the broad bottom edge, while the darker green makes a smaller triangle inside it.

title: Malachite Necklace
description: I set this malachite with the narrow end up. Follow the dark green stripe down the left side and you’ll see it hook across the bottom. That bend fits right into the round end of the teardrop.

title: Blue Mountain Jasper Necklace
description: I see gray-blue on the broad end of this Blue Mountain jasper, with a rusty brown streak above it. The sides draw together gently where the stone meets the chain.

title: Plume Agate Necklace
description: The lower end of this plume agate looks almost clear beside the dark cluster higher up. I set it as a teardrop so the little specks have room to spread out across the face.

title: Mexican Crazy Lace Agate Necklace
description: This Mexican crazy lace agate is long enough to follow the red and cream from one end to the other. My eye goes to the pale strip through the middle where the two sides change color.

title: Mexican Crazy Lace Agate Necklace
description: I see a little pale loop inside this dark crazy lace pendant. The stone comes to a point below it, so that little loop sits right on the centerline when it hangs.

title: Serpentine Necklace
description: I set this serpentine with the long pale streak showing against the deep green. The stone has a slanted lower edge, and the streak almost meets its corner.

title: Serpentine Necklace
description: A narrow green patch runs up the cream-colored face of this serpentine. I like the angular cut here. The little stone hangs with one corner pointing down.

title: Brazilian Agate Freeform Egg with an Open Druzy Portal
description: That opening in the side is deep enough to catch a shadow. I held this agate egg in the sun so you can see the little crystals in the hollow and the peach-colored stone around it.

title: Carnelian Free-form
description: From this angle I see a curl of white reaching into the orange carnelian. The stone is rounded above it and the edge kicks out just below, right where the orange comes back.

title: Septarian Sphere
description: I turned this septarian sphere so the golden patch faces up. Dark brown and gray wrap around it like pieces of a puzzle, with a much darker patch down near my thumb.

title: Volcano "Football" Agate Sphere
description: My eye goes straight to the round marking on this agate sphere. It has a tan rim around a darker middle, with blue-gray stone sweeping around the other side.

title: Tumbled Lake Superior Agate Specimen
description: There’s a little dark oval inside a larger gray one on this tumbled agate. I’d set it on its long edge as pictured so you can see both rings at once.

title: Polished Water Level Montana Agate Slab
description: I like how the curved top of this Montana agate cuts across the nearly level bands. The pale stripes run almost the full width, with a fine dark line crossing them near one side.

title: Snowflake Obsidian Necklace
description: I framed this snowflake obsidian oval with a beaded-looking edge. There are several pale patches inside that frame, with a black strip of stone winding between them.

title: Crazy Lace Agate Necklace
description: I can trace the pink and brown bands down one side of this crazy lace and back up the other. The stone comes to an off-center point just below that turn.

title: Plume Agate Necklace
description: The uneven bottom edge is part of what I like about this plume agate. The face is pale pink and cream with a little pocket of warm brown near the middle.

title: Morrisonite Jasper Necklace
description: I cut this Morrisonite like a long leaf, pointed at both ends. Fine yellow and red lines run lengthwise through the orange face and meet up near the tips.

title: Purple Moss Agate Necklace
description: I see deep purple up near the bail on this moss agate and a dense patch of darker markings farther down. Those sloping sides come together in a short point under the patch.

title: Cotton Candy Agate Necklace
description: There’s a little pale ring in the upper half of this cotton candy agate. I set it point down, with the white markings spreading across the pink toward the bottom of the drop.

title: Rosetta Jasper with Quartz inclusions Necklace
description: I kept the reddish patch in the middle of this Rosetta jasper pendant. Pale quartz shows along the side and at the bottom, where the outline narrows to a point.

title: Chevron Amethyst Necklace
description: I set this chevron amethyst with the long sides straight so those white zigzags show clearly. Follow the wide band across the lavender and it doubles back before it reaches the other edge.

title: Rhodenite
description: I set this pink stone with a straight top and a short point below. The little dark lines along one edge break up an otherwise broad patch of pink.

title: Purple Fluorite Necklace
description: I can pick out several shades of purple in this fluorite, all broken up by white. The slim pendant has a point at each end, with the busiest patch right across the middle.

title: Agatized Petrified Wood Necklace
description: I can follow curved brown lines through the pale center of this agatized petrified wood. I set the widest part of the drop at the bottom, where the lines bunch together.

title: Red Ocean Jasper Necklace
description: What catches my eye in this red ocean jasper is the crooked white streak. It runs up from the lower edge and fades out against a broad rusty red face.

title: Biggs Jasper Necklace
description: What I notice on this Biggs jasper is the stack of brown bands down low. Above them is a much busier patch that narrows as it gets closer to the bail.

title: Biggs Jasper Necklace
description: I laid this Biggs jasper on its cord for the photo. A dark, crooked line crosses the long, pale face, dividing the cream at the broad end from the grayer stone up near the loop.

title: Rainbow Fluorite Sphere
description: Held in my hand, this fluorite sphere shows purple across the top and a broad smoky band around the middle. A paler stripe curls up into view along the bottom.

title: Chocolate Onyx Tower
description: I can follow a thin cream line across the honey-brown face of this onyx tower and around the corner. Higher up, the bands crowd closer together just below the point.

title: Blue Tiger's Eye Sphere
description: I held this blue tiger’s eye sphere outdoors for the picture. The dark face picks up the sky and the trees. Look below the bright reflection for the bands running through the stone itself.

title: Trancas Geode
description: The hollow in this Trancas geode goes dark toward the back. I’d turn the opening toward you so you can see the pale crystals along the lip and the rough outside just beyond them.

title: Dendritic Agate Necklace
description: I like where the dark little branches gather along the edge of this agate pendant. Much of the center stays pale enough to see the finer marks, and the whole drop hangs point down.

title: Agatized Petrified Wood Necklace
description: I set this oval of agatized petrified wood in a frame with a patterned edge. The stone has a broad brown patch above a pale, speckled one, with a little patch of honey color where they meet.

title: Rugged Mookaite Necklace
description: The crooked lower edge is what gives this mookaite pendant its shape. I hung it with the pale patch near the top and the ocher-colored stone trailing down one side.

title: Mahogany Obsidian
description: This mahogany obsidian hangs long and narrow. I can just make out the dark reddish brown through the middle, with a band of nearly black stone around the rounded foot.

title: Polished Purple Fluorite Specimen
description: I’d stand this purple fluorite on its broad base to show the pale streak down the sloping side. The opposite side is a much deeper purple, almost to the pointed top.

title: Thunder Bay Amethyst Specimen
description: I like the side view of this amethyst. You can see the purple points standing up in a row and the pale stone they’re attached to underneath.

title: Face Polished Baker Ranch Thunder Egg Specimen
description: I’ve shown the polished face of this thunder egg straight on. There’s a rusty red shape inside a dark band, with a rougher-looking border following the whole arch.

title: Polished Lake Superior Agate
description: Look near the top of this polished agate and you’ll see a pale loop drawn through the brown. I held it with that loop facing the camera so you can follow the fine lines inside it.

title: Amethyst Geode Cluster
description: My eye goes to the stray purple point on the high side of this geode. Look down from there and the purple crystals give way to a thin, wavy gray band along the base.

title: Face Polished Oregon Polka Dot Agate Slab
description: I like the line where the smoky gray meets the rusty bands at the foot of this slab. Farther up, little amber patches show through the pale polished face.

title: Petrified Wood Specimen
description: The grain runs nearly the whole width of this piece of petrified wood. I’d show it lying lengthwise as pictured, with the uneven outside edge along the top.

title: Oregon Carrasite Jasper Specimen
description: There’s a patch of slate blue between the ocher bands on this Carrasite jasper. I see it best with the narrow end up and the banded foot facing forward.

title: Vanadinite Crystal Cluster Specimen
description: I start at the edge of this vanadinite cluster. You can see the orange-red crystals against a strip of pale stone there, then follow them across the whole face.

title: Idaho Graveyard Point Plume Agate Specimen
description: Most of the markings on this plume agate crowd the long lower edge. I like the quieter gray area above them where you can pick out individual little wisps.

title: Green Fluorite Tower with a Druzy Edge
description: A pair of pale lines runs up the green face of this fluorite tower. I like where the smooth faces meet the irregular druzy edge. You can see both of them in the same view.

title: Black Galaxy Amethyst Geode
description: The crystals on this amethyst geode are small enough that I see a field of bright points before I see individual shapes. A dark rim follows the uneven outline around them.
